'''Suzdice''' was a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] stage [[Actor/Legends|actor]]. Suzdice claimed to find exercise of the Clawdite [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting]] abilities to be excruciatingly painful.<ref name="Standoff on Leritor" />
